latest_release.name: Qiskit  2.6.2
latest_release.body:
# Changelog
## Fixed
-   Set recursion limit for QPY deserialization (#17413)
-   Fix QASM3 export of decomposed gate params (#16997) (#17420)
-   Enforce buffer overwrite safety in `qk_circuit_inst_unitary` (#17418)
-   Avoid SymbolExpr string parser for Qpy loading of sympy expressions (#16745) (#17414)
-   Fix WrapAngles angle bounds ignorance inside control flow (#17349) (#17404)
-   Making SynthesizeRZRotations recursive (#17359) (#17362)
-   Fixed control-flow handling for Clifford+T compilation (#17318) (#17356)
